# L1 Vision

## What Lanternfield is

Lanternfield is a small tool that lets a neighbourhood library lend out lanterns, books and board games from one shelf. It exists so volunteers spend less time on paper cards.

## Who it is for

Volunteer librarians and the members who borrow items. Nobody else uses it.

## Vocabulary

A loan is one item taken home for a set number of days. A member is a person with a library card.
